text:
Sarah K.: Hey finance — invoice from Quasar Dataworks (INV-2026-314) got rejected by AP. Vendor added tax as a separate line and used PO-88421 but that PO was moved to a different cost center last week. Can someone help route/approve?
Mike C.: Seen the rejection: "PO mismatch / tax allocation not allowed". We either need the PO updated to include tax or a procurement memo validating the tax.
Raj P.: FYI PO-88421 was reclassified to COST-ENG-3 when we consolidated projects. PO record exists but approver routing now points to Julia W. so AP probably can't match the approver.
Sarah K.: AP Bot shows: "Invoice missing matching PO line for tax amount". Procurement, can you either add a tax line to the PO or confirm a one-off approver?
Julia W.: I can approve. Need Raj to confirm spend is valid under COST-ENG-3 so I have an audit trail. If AP insists on PO amendment I can request PO reopen but that takes ~2 business days.
Raj P.: Confirmed: Quasar Dataworks Q1 latency reports are billable to COST-ENG-3, tax is legitimate. @Julia W. please approve this invoice.
AP Bot: "Invoice INV-2026-314: held — awaiting approver confirmation or PO amendment. Add comment/attach supporting doc to release."
procure-bot: "PO-88421 status: closed -> reopen_requested by Julia W. ETA 2 business days if change approved."
Mike C.: Sarah, can you attach the vendor statement and Raj's confirmation to the AP ticket? That should unblock quicker than PO reopen. Also let's add tax guidance to the PO template. :clipboard:
Sarah K.: Uploaded vendor statement and pasted Raj's note into ticket FIN-3421 (https://redwood.atlassian/browse/FIN-3421). @Julia W. please approve in the AP UI when you have a sec.
Julia W.: Approved in AP system and requested PO reopen. procure-bot acknowledged reopen_requested.
AP Bot: "Invoice INV-2026-314: approval recorded by Julia W. — queued for payment processing. Expected payment run next Tue."
Sarah K.: Great, thanks everyone. I'll close FIN-3421 after payment clears. Action item: procurement to add tax handling guidance to PO checklist. :white_check_mark:
